problems.description: Employees receive emails that appear to come from trusted vendors requesting urgent payment updates. The emails contain links to fraudulent websites designed to capture payment information.
risk_reduction: Implement email authentication protocols like SPF, DKIM, and DMARC
Conduct regular phishing awareness training for employees
Use advanced email filtering solutions to detect and block phishing attempts

problems.description: High-profile executives receive targeted emails that appear to come from colleagues, tricking them into revealing sensitive information or transferring funds.
risk_reduction: Establish a verification process for financial transactions
Train executives on recognizing spear phishing tactics
Utilize email security solutions that analyze sender behavior

problems.description: C-level executives are targeted with highly personalized emails that exploit their interests or recent activities, leading to significant financial loss or data breaches.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication for executive accounts
Conduct regular security training focused on whaling tactics
Monitor and analyze email traffic for unusual patterns

problems.description: An attacker intercepts communication between a user and a web application, capturing session tokens and gaining unauthorized access to user accounts.
risk_reduction: Enforce HTTPS for all web applications to encrypt data in transit
Implement secure cookie attributes (e.g., HttpOnly, Secure)
Use session timeouts and re-authentication for sensitive actions

problems.description: Users connect to unsecured public Wi-Fi networks, allowing attackers to intercept and manipulate data transmitted over the network.
risk_reduction: Encourage the use of VPNs when accessing public Wi-Fi
Educate users about the risks of connecting to unsecured networks
Implement network segmentation to limit exposure to sensitive data

problems.description: An attacker downgrades a user's connection from HTTPS to HTTP, allowing them to intercept sensitive information such as login credentials.
risk_reduction: Enforce HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security) on web applications
Educate users to check for HTTPS in the browser before entering sensitive information
Use secure coding practices to prevent protocol downgrades
